adaptations.reason: Remove GeoIP and KV/cache packages from the product scope. Full upstream trees of retained packages are preserved; protobuf and API DTO remain required by the pinned RoadRunner HTTP package.

Replace Nyholm and PSR HTTP/factory/log packages with concrete core HTTP types and the existing own Logger contract. RoadRunner uses only the native HttpWorker API; the unused upstream PSR7 adapter source and original require metadata are retained for provenance, never loaded or registered as a core adapter.

Upgrade the fixed RoadRunner transport to RR3: worker 3.8.0, HTTP 4.2.1, Goridge 4.6.0, API DTO 2.1.0 and compatibility metapackage 3.0.0. Preserve full upstream archives/notices, rebase both worker patches, keep native HttpWorker composition and omit Composer/PSR/Nyholm loading.
